_note: Maps each training source's raw label to the class the on-device model outputs (OPEN_QUESTIONS Q135). Class names equal the practice-card section keys in app/assets/config/practice_cards.json where a card exists (canker, greening); 'healthy' and 'other' have no card. Black spot and melanose have no practice card, so they map to 'other'. To add a class (e.g. from field photos exported by the server), add its key to 'classes' and give it photos with --extra; the order of 'classes' is the order of labels.txt.

mendeley_hlb_mexico._note: Folder names as read from the archive (version 3, run log '[mendeley] tree:'): 'Database HLB Sanas Final/HOJAS CON SINTOMAS' (leaves with symptoms, 270) and '.../HOJAS SANAS' (healthy leaves, 379) are the raw photos and match the paper's 270 HLB / 379 control. The second zip ('Database HLB and Healthy - Final') holds preprocessed_images and visualizations made from the same photos; they are left out on purpose, as a class seen only in processed form lets the model learn the processing instead of the disease. Matching is a case-insensitive substring test; an image takes the class of its nearest matching folder; a folder matching two classes labels nothing; unmatched images are skipped and listed in the model card.

extra._note: Name of an --extra subfolder -> class. A folder whose name is already in 'classes' needs no entry here; any other name stops the run with an error.
